author: Cleo Abram
description:
How far away is the farthest thing humans have ever made? 

If you shot out into space at the speed of light, after 22 minutes, you’d reach Mars.

You reach the last planet in our solar system after 4 hours and 10 minutes.

But we’re chasing the farthest man made object ever sent, so we keep going!

After traveling 24 hours at the speed of light you're now One LIGHT DAY from earth, this is where Voyager-1 is now! And it’s carrying photos for aliens, to see them…WATCH THIS. 

#voyager1 #space #light #speed #science #NASA
title: How Far Is the FARTHEST Thing Humans Ever Made?
